title: A 20-tonne lead-melting furnace: batch capacity versus molten-lead pump flow
summary: Lead-alloy melting capacity and molten-lead pump flow describe different stages. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s electrically heated proposal dated 21 February 2019 specifies a rated 20 t of lead per batch, while the pump is listed at a maximum 60 t/h and a head of 5 m. The first is a proposed batch quantity; the second concerns transfer equipment. Pumping capacity does not establish how much lead the furnace melts each hour. Separate melting batches from downstream withdrawal cycles before checking their coordination.
